body:
## Pull request overview

This PR implements ObjectStack kernel API specifications to support ObjectUI requirements, focusing on batch operations, metadata caching, error standardization, full-text search, and view persistence.

**Changes:**
- Added batch operations API with atomic transaction support (max 200 records per batch)
- Implemented ETag-based metadata caching with conditional requests
- Standardized 50+ error codes with categorization and retry guidance
- Extended query schema with full-text search capabilities
- Added view storage API for persisting UI configurations

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 62 out of 62 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

| packages/spec/src/api/batch.test.ts | Added batch operation validation tests |

| content/docs/references/* | Added documentation for new system protocols (logging, metrics, tracing) |
</details>

The new documentation files (tracing.mdx, metrics.mdx, logging.mdx) are added but lack examples or usage scenarios beyond the basic schema documentation. Consider adding practical examples showing how these protocols integrate with the batch operations, caching, and error handling features introduced in this PR to provide better context for developers.
